crossrefs.text: Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night. For over all the glory there will be a canopy,
But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders. But you will name your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
But I will camp around My house because of an army, because of those who march to and fro, and never again will an oppressor overrun My people, for now I keep watch with My own eyes.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
So He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze. He was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
